description: Dynamic arrays at the node level (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §6, §2): a node value may be an array, a reference to an array-valued node returns the WHOLE array (no spill onto neighbors), and array-of-arrays is rejected (#CALC!). Array CONTENTS coincide with Excel array semantics (§5) and are verified via value-equivalence, not asserted here.

cases.name: a reference to an array-valued node returns the whole array
cases.note: List is a node whose value is a 1x3 array; =List returns the whole array on this node (no inter-node spill). Contents are Excel-anchored.

cases.name: INDEX selects from an array-valued node
cases.note: List resolves to the array node; INDEX(List,1) picks an element. The element value is Excel-anchored.

cases.name: a result that is an array of arrays is rejected

expect.reason: an operation producing an EvalValue::Array whose cells are themselves arrays errors with #CALC! (§6, nested arrays rejected)

cases.note: MAP(List, x -> List) would build an array whose cells are the 1x3 array -> #CALC! at bind/runtime.
